meta.purpose: Answer key for artifact_org-a_proj-a1_lakehouse.md — violations concentrated in Data, Observability and Technology (not Security). Never shown to the model.

expected_findings.evidence: The Lake Store holds confidential data in plaintext; encryption at rest has not been enabled.
A copy of the personal-data tables is replicated to a US-East region, outside the approved EU region.
Each service writes logs to local files; there is no centralised log or metric collection.
The Lake Store runs on Mongoose-DB, which is not on the approved technology catalogue.
The Lake Store data is classified as confidential.
Ingestion and analyst traffic use TLS 1.3.
